Marcus, I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", but the $2,101 rate is not in it yet.

Hollis is on the Central team, not the North team. Under our finance-figure rule, a per-seat rate can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark, and the account owner, so I can't put it in a mail to Hollis without approval. I've asked June Osei-Lark by DM to approve it. The draft has a `[RATE PENDING APPROVAL]` placeholder, and nothing has been sent.

Once June approves, I can insert the rate into the draft and tell you. Until then, you can use the draft as is. It is in your mailbox, and you send it yourself.
